description: Search National Digital's published pages - services, articles, case studies and pricing - for a topic or keyword. Pages that contain every word rank first, and a word matches as a prefix. Returns up to 20 ranked results (8 by default), each with an id, title, url, type, a short excerpt and the page's trail, plus the total number of pages that match at least one word, which is never fewer than the results returned. Pass a result's id to fetch for the page's full text.

query.description: Words describing the topic, service or question.

type.description: Limit results to one kind of page: Pillar (a service area), Hub (a service), Leaf (an in-depth guide), CaseStudy (a client project) or Static (company pages such as /about/ and /services/).

name: search

evidence.description: Verified claims about National Digital that match the query, each with the page that proves it. Quote a claim only with its proof URL.

title: Search National Digital pages
